section_summary: Section covers 1947-1949 reporting on narcotics trade under the 1925 Geneva Opium Convention and 1931 Limitation Convention for Japan, Korea and the Ryukyus. It includes statistical forms, transmittal notes and acknowledgements from the Permanent Central Opium Board, the Treasury Bureau of Narcotics and the US UN mission, and the 1947 and 1948 annual reports on Japanese narcotics control and illicit traffic, with case summaries. It also includes SCAP's Ryukyus estimate amendments and UN requests for 1948 reports.
